Diagnosis:
CAUSE: HPA shop/search is pinned at its maxReplicas of 3, because the Deployment load in namespace shop runs three busybox loops that call http://search nonstop, pushing search CPU to 186% of request against a 50% target.

EVIDENCE:
1. describe hpa/search (namespace shop, my check): Min 1, Max 3, "Deployment pods: 3 current / 3 desired", CPU "186% (18m) / 50%" as a percentage of request, ScalingLimited=True with reason TooManyReplicas ("desired replica count is more than the maximum replica count").
2. describe deployment/load (shop, diag-k8s): image docker.io/library/busybox:1.37, command `for i in 1 2 3; do (while true; do wget -q -O /dev/null http://search; done) & done; wait`, CPU request 10m, limit 500m, 1/1 available.
3. get pod (shop, diag-k8s): load-55fdc5b776-ktjb5 has IP 10.244.2.74 and is Running 1/1. The search pods are 10.244.2.73, 10.244.2.75 and 10.244.1.16.
4. logs search-5ccfdcf4cf-l7m4v, tail 50 (shop, diag-k8s): every line is `10.244.2.74 ... "GET / HTTP/1.1" 200 615 "-" "Wget"`, so the caller is the load pod.
5. events (shop, diag-k8s): HPA/search Normal SuccessfulRescale "New size: 3; reason: cpu resource utilization (percentage of request) above target". Earlier Warning FailedGetResourceMetric "no metrics returned from resource metrics API" and FailedComputeMetricsReplicas (my describe hpa/search, events section, confirms both).

FIX (not applied): scale the Deployment load in namespace shop to zero replicas (or delete it), provided the traffic is not legitimate; if it is, raise the HPA maxReplicas above 3 instead.

Fact.Name: source
Fact.Value: the load comes from the Deployment `load`, which calls `search`

Fact.Name: fix (not applied)
Fact.Value: raise `maxReplicas` within bounds, or the CPU request; or stop the load if it is not legitimate
